newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Dexia jumps 3 pct on arbitrage.
newsitem.headline: Dexia jumps 3 pct on arbitrage.

text.p: Shares in Belgian French bancassurance group Dexia jumped three percent on Monday, with traders putting it down to a mixture of arbitrage between CLF and Dexia and a technical correction from recent falls.
"It has been very weak during the last week, so there's some recovery in Dexia and there is always some arbitrage between CLF and Dexia shares," trader Benoit Kint at brokerage Petercam said.
By 1310 GMT the share was up 3.04 percent at 3,610 Belgian francs, slightly off its earlier high of 3,650, with a 100 million Belgian francs of the share traded.
The share price has fallen 8.5 percent since March 27.
"It's more a technical reaction than anything else, because no new news concerning Dexia has come out," a trader said.
Credit Communal de Belgique/Gemeentekrediet (CCB) and Credit Local de France (CLF) together form Dexia, a group mainly active in public sector lending.
CLF was up 3.42 percent at 575 French francs.
